MessagesController broadcasts sidebar replaces to all participants when a new message is sent. Unread indicators, last message preview, and timestamp update in real-time.

Added Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store response headers to FeedController#read_status and #post_actions. Prevents Turbo from caching these lazy frame GET responses, so back/forward navigation always fetches the current read state from the server.

The Cache-Control header alone didn't fix it because Turbo uses its own sessionStorage cache, not HTTP cache. Added frame_cache_controller.js Stimulus controller that removes the src attribute after each turbo:frame-load event. This prevents Turbo from re-fetching lazy frame content on back/forward navigation. The Turbo cache snapshot retains the correct frame state (checkmark or button) without refetch.

Fixed the flickering issue during Turbo history restoration and background page updates by listening to the 'turbo:before-render' event in frame_cache_controller.js. This ensures that any lazy-loaded frames that have already been loaded (with their 'src' removed) have their loaded content copied and 'src' removed in the incoming body before Turbo performs the page render, preventing a fallback to the placeholder and a redundant HTTP request.
